messages.author: Lara rajam
messages.body:
Dear AMBER
I am trying to use the force field for LYS- Trimethylated residue from
http://amber.manchester.ac.uk
I am having an issue - after loading the prep file then moving to frcmod
the xleap crashes saying an error as below.
!FATAL ERROR----------------------------------------
!FATAL:    In file [varArray.c], line 106
!FATAL:    Message:  PVarArrayIndex: VARARRAY is NULL!
!ABORTING.
Any insights are much appreciated.
I followed the below one from the force field site.
trimethyllysine (K3M) PREP <
http://amber.manchester.ac.uk/pro/K3M.prep
>
FRCMOD <
http://amber.manchester.ac.uk/pro/K3M.frcmod
> Machado
<
http://amber.manchester.ac.uk/pro/K3M_inf.html
>
